_comment: Glassworks for generic Android's budgets (#23, #68), the S1's rules (frames/aqara-s1-plus/budgets.json; docs/size.md and docs/perf.md say why and how each is measured). CI's size check (tools/size/apksize.py, pr.yml's size-generic job) reads size and panes.*.size_max_bytes and fails a PR that goes over unless the same PR raises the budget. The size budgets are the 2026-11-15 release build (unsigned, measured with apksize.py: 100.82 MB arm64-v8a, 97.88 MB armeabi-v7a) plus about 2.5%, and each pane's size about twice its own then, at least 100 kB (assist 1.47 MB arm64-v8a with TensorFlow Lite's native library, sendspin 0.07 MB, timers 0.03 MB). The RAM budgets aren't set yet: see _todo_ram. Until then Clarity's report uses tools/perf/budgets.json for `ram`, and has no per-pane RAM budget for this frame.
_todo_ram: TODO(#23): per-pane RAM, from the root's Clarity run on the S1 and the Pixel Tablet (Android 14+, arm64). Add, per pane, "ram_pss_max_kb": <whole KB>, the pane's PSS on by itself against every pane off, as frames/aqara-s1-plus/budgets.json has them (48 MB for assist and sendspin there, set before a measurement), and a frame-wide "ram": {"app_pss_max_pct_of_ram": <int>, "device_available_min_pct": <int>} if the tablet needs other numbers than tools/perf/budgets.json's. Then delete this key.
